method.label: Separate the cylinder and end caps

annotationRationale: Identifying the region as a composite solid is the central step. The cylinder and sphere volume formulas then determine the segment length.
sourceMethod: Followed MAA's decomposition into a cylinder and two hemispheres, clarifying why the distance condition produces these pieces.

review.mathCheck: Projection onto the segment partitions the region into a radius-3 cylinder and two outward hemispheres. Thus \(9\pi h+36\pi=216\pi\), giving \(h=20\), choice D. Shared boundary disks do not affect volume.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of official solution 8 on page 3. The candidate adds a useful perpendicular-plane and nearest-point justification for the same decomposition.
review.annotationCheck: Composite-solid recognition is appropriately assessed, with cylinder and sphere formulas as supporting knowledge. The explanation supplies enough geometry to reconstruct the solid without a figure.
